title: Wanderings and Victories

questions.question: How long did Israel wander before turning north?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:14 (ESV): "And the time from our leaving Kadesh-barnea until we crossed the brook Zered was thirty-eight years..."

questions.question: Which peoples did God tell Israel not to provoke?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:5, 9, 19 (ESV): "Do not contend with them [Edom]... Do not harass Moab... Do not harass them or contend with them [Ammon]..."

questions.question: Who was the Amorite king Israel defeated first?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:24, 32 (ESV): "‘Rise up... and contend with Sihon... Then Sihon came out against us... and we defeated him..."

questions.question: What did God give Israel from Sihon’s land?
options: From the Arnon to the Jabbok
questions.correctAnswer: From the Arnon to the Jabbok
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:36 (ESV): "From Aroer... as far as Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The Lord our God gave all into our hands."

questions.question: Through whose territory did God say they would pass?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:4 (ESV): "You are about to pass through the territory of your brothers the people of Esau, who live in Seir..."

questions.question: What were the people commanded to pay for?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:6 (ESV): "You shall purchase food from them with money... and you shall also buy water from them with money..."

questions.question: Who dwelt in Seir before the descendants of Esau?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:12 (ESV): "The Horites also lived in Seir formerly, but the people of Esau dispossessed them..."

questions.question: Who were the Zamzummim?
options: People great and tall like the Anakim
questions.correctAnswer: People great and tall like the Anakim
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:20-21 (ESV): "...the Ammonites call them Zamzummim, a people great and many, and tall as the Anakim..."

questions.question: God hardened the spirit of which king?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:30 (ESV): "But Sihon the king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for the Lord your God hardened his spirit..."

questions.question: What happened to the men, women, and little ones of Sihon's cities?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:34 (ESV): "And we captured all his cities at that time and devoted to destruction every city, men, women, and little ones. We left no survivors."

questions.question: What land did God NOT give to Israel in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:37 (ESV): "Only to the land of the sons of Ammon you did not draw near..."

questions.question: The Emim were formerly inhabitants of which land?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:9-10 (ESV): "...Ar to the people of Lot... The Emim formerly lived there..."

questions.question: The Caphtorim came from where to destroy the Avvim?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:23 (ESV): "...the Caphtorim, who came from Caphtor, destroyed them..."

questions.question: How much land of Esau did God say He would give Israel?
options: Not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on
questions.correctAnswer: Not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:5 (ESV): "I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on..."

questions.question: What did God say began on "this day" regarding the nations?
options: The dread and fear of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The dread and fear of Israel
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 2:25 (ESV): "This day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole heaven..."

key_verse_text: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He knows your going through this great wilderness. These forty years the LORD your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing. (ESV)
